Method.name: ProcessHttpsRequest
Method.Implementation:
#dim tSC As %Status=$$$OK $$$TRACE("Inside Method ProcessHttpsRequest with token: " _ pRequest.accessToken)
Set token=pRequest.accessToken Set tStream = "" Set tStream = ##class(%Stream.GlobalCharacter).%New() Do tStream.Write(pRequest.stringObject) Set tStr = tStream.Read() $$$TRACE("Data string: " _ tStr) Do tStream.Rewind()
Set httprequest=##class(%Net.HttpRequest).%New()
$$$TRACE("URL: "_..Adapter.URL) Set tAdURL = "https://" _ ..Adapter.HTTPServer _ ..Adapter.URL, tAdURL1=$E(tAdURL) $$$TRACE("Location: "_tAdURL) Set httprequest.SSLConfiguration = ..Adapter.SSLConfig $$$TRACE("SSL Config: "_httprequest.SSLConfiguration) Set httprequest.Https="1"
Set httprequest.ContentType="application/json" do httprequest.SetHeader("apikey", ..ApiKey) Do httprequest.EntityBody.Write() do httprequest.EntityBody.CopyFrom(tStream) set httprequest.Timeout=..Adapter.ResponseTimeout
set tSC=##class(%SYS.OAuth2.AccessToken).AuthorizeWithAccessToken(httprequest,"header",..Adapter.SSLConfig,"PingSecurityToken",token) $$$TRACE("Authorize Token status "_tSC) if ($$$ISERR(tSC)) { return tSC }
set tSC = httprequest.Post(tAdURL)
if $$$ISERR(tSC) { do $system.OBJ.DisplayError() Quit tSC } else { set outStr = "" set tHttpResponse=httprequest.HttpResponse $$$TRACE("Status: "_tHttpResponse.StatusLine _ ", " _ tHttpResponse.Data) // %Stream.GlobalCharacter set stream = tHttpResponse.Data While 'stream.AtEnd { set outStr = stream.ReadLine(,.sc,.eol) $$$TRACE("Response: " _ outStr) } set pResponse = ##class(Ens.StringContainer).%New() set pResponse.StringValue = outStr }
quit tSC
